scope: English top flight: Football League (1888-89 to 1891-92), Football League First Division (1892-93 to 1991-92), Premier League (1992-93 onward)
source: https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/ (season final tables 1888-89 to 2007-08, points and cross-check)

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id, the id FootSimu uses for clubs (same ids as src/data/history.json)
fieldNotes.footsimuSlug: club page slug on footsimu.com (slugify of current name)
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now (2026-27), without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points after any deductions; 2 points per win until 1980-81, 3 from 1981-82
fieldNotes.name: club name used that season
fieldNotes.currentName: club as it is known today
fieldNotes.tournament: always null for the Premier League
